id: \bCongratulations on winning the Manalo Conference and becoming the Alolan Champion.
en: \bCongratulations on winning the Manalo Conference and becoming the Alolan Champion.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto la Conferenza di Manalo e per essere diventato Campione di Alola.

id: \bSpeak to Professor Kukui whenever you're ready to start the ceremony.
en: \bSpeak to Professor Kukui whenever you're ready to start the ceremony.
it: \bParla con il Professor Kukui quando sei pronto per iniziare la cerimonia.

id: \bGladion: So, it's just you and me, \PN. Let's not wait any longer.
en: \bGladion: So, it's just you and me, \PN. Let's not wait any longer.
it: \bIridio: Allora siamo rimasti solo io e te, \PN. Non aspettiamo oltre.

id: \bKukui: Are you pumped, cousin? This match may just be for fun but I'm going to give it everything I have.
en: \bKukui: Are you pumped, cousin? This match may just be for fun but I'm going to give it everything I have.
it: \bKukui: Sei carico, cugino? Questo incontro sarà anche solo per divertimento, ma io darò tutto quello che ho.

id: \bKukui: Wonderful fight. Perhaps we can do it again someday.
en: \bKukui: Wonderful fight. Perhaps we can do it again someday.
it: \bKukui: Lotta splendida. Magari un giorno potremo rifarla.

id: \bThis wasn't for any reward, but you deserve this.
en: \bThis wasn't for any reward, but you deserve this.
it: \bNon era per nessuna ricompensa, ma questo te lo meriti.
